messages:
Anna: quick heads-up — ran a focused profiling pass on the Dedicated runtime in ACME VPC. Found two consistent perf regressions on the causal LLM workload: kernel selector picks "fused_attn_generic" for some layers, adding ~8-12ms/token; and KV cache churn under bursty traffic causing cache-miss spike (~30% of tokens). attaching flame graph: https://internal.s3/redwood/profiles/1763445600/flame.svg :file_folder:

Josh: can you paste the top-level numbers? we need to know delta vs baseline and which routes are impacted.

Anna: baseline median token latency 18ms, current 26ms for route /generate/acme. Breakdown from `perfstat` (5m window): token_decode_time 14.2ms, kv_lookup_time 4.8ms, kernel_sched_time 3.6ms, batch_wait_time 3.4ms. So kv+kernel = ~8.4ms extra.

Emil: looks like the kernel selector fallback triggered because seq_len distribution shifted to many >384 tokens. quick heuristic: prefer `attn_blocked` when seq_len>256 and per-device batch<12; also add a scoring term for last-layer size. pushing a branch with selector tweak: `runtime/kernel_selector/heuristic/seqlen-priority`.

Sara: for Private/VPC customers we also need to expose token-level metrics so customer's Prometheus can show per-route KPIs. Suggested metrics: `redwood_token_latency_seconds_sum` / `_count`, `redwood_kv_lookup_seconds_*`, `redwood_kernel_schedule_seconds_*`. these must be label-safe (route, model, customer, device_pool). Air-gapped customers need an offline export: tarball with exporter binary + prometheus rules + grafana dashboard json. cc: @Josh

Josh: agree. for air-gapped we can't rely on pushgateway. plan: exporter runs inside customer VPC and writes to local prometheus, we provide Grafana json + recording rules. also need scrape configs example and systemd unit. I'll prepare a sample repo.

Anna: snippet of the profiler output:

```
# perf summary (route /generate/acme)
tokens: 1.2M
median_token_latency_ms: 26
token_decode_time_ms: 14.2
kv_lookup_time_ms: 4.8
kernel_sched_time_ms: 3.6
batch_wait_time_ms: 3.4
kernel_selector: fused_attn_generic -> fallback on layers [8,9,10]
```

Emil: small runtime patch idea: add a backoff window for kv evictions: if cache_miss_rate > 5% && burstiness_score > 0.7 then increase cache retention by 2x for 30s. This should cut miss tail. I'll open PR with tests and a simple simulation harness.

Sara: one more infra note: in Private we must avoid exporting per-token PII. ensure metrics labels are hashed or redacted — route names may contain user IDs. add policy: allowlist routes + label_relabeling. I'll add to ops checklist.

Josh: action items: (1) Anna to land kernel_selector heuristic patch and perf numbers (2) Emil to PR kv backoff and sim (3) Josh to assemble air-gapped metrics package (prom rules + grafana panels) (4) Sara to add privacy relabeling policy. target: canary rollout to one ACME shard next week. :thumbsup: 

Anna: LGTM, will start canary tomorrow and post results here.

perf-bot: automated perf check queued: https://ci.redwood/inference/profiles/1763445600 :robot_face: 

Emily: will update the dashboard to include token-level waterfall (decode | kv | kernel | wait) per-route; will attach panel json once ready.

Anna: thanks everyone. please @mention me on PRs so I can coordinate the canary.
